cohort: 110 patients with a history of previous abdominal surgery scheduled for laparoscopy
finding: The preoperative ultrasonographic sliding sign was found to be a highly accurate (90%) method for predicting intra-abdominal adhesions in patients with previous abdominal surgery.
mod_finding: The study found that the estimates of vesicouterine adhesions, as well as actual adhesions, increased with the total number of cesarean sections (P = .008).
